About this website

An independent portfolio project.

Fieldwork is a fictional small-business website created to demonstrate frontend development.

What is fictional?

The studio name, designer, project names, locations, dates, sizes, service prices and testimonial are illustrative. The photographs are real stock photographs used as garden inspiration; they do not document completed Fieldwork commissions.

Photography

  • Darren Richardson on Unsplash — hero garden

  • Belov Sergey on Unsplash — planting detail
  • Antje Winkler on Unsplash — rose path

Images are used under the Unsplash License and stored locally in optimized WebP format.

Your data

The form runs in your browser. It does not send, upload or persist your inputs. A text file is created only when you choose to download the summary. This website has no analytics, cookies or local storage added by the project code; the hosting provider may maintain its own technical logs.
